items.summary: Update the Question screen user-facing text so the main prompt is Chocolate Day themed (not Valentine themed) and asks the user to accept the Chocolate Day wish. The Question screen must continue to show exactly two options: “Yes” and “No”.

Update the Celebration screen shown after clicking “Yes” to display a Chocolate Day themed message and the Chocolate Day illustration (boy wishing a girl Happy Chocolate Day while proposing on one knee), instead of the current Valentine “Good choice” meme content.
